findings.text: When the trimmed stack has fewer than three lines, `stackWithoutTwoTopLines` becomes '' and `endsWith('')` is always true. The original regex did not match in that case and compared against the whole stack. An example is a small `Error.stackTraceLimit`, which gives a two-frame stack like 'a\nb'. The request-side stack is then never appended to `err.stack`, so the async call-site trace is silently dropped.
